title: Triage one support issue with a Glean Agent
description: Give a published support-triage Agent one issue URL or description and get an evidence-backed summary, next diagnostic step, and customer-safe response.

questions.prompt: What is your work email? It is used once to discover your Glean tenant.
What is the ID of the published conversational support-triage Agent to run?
What support issue should the Agent triage? Paste a ticket URL or a concise issue description.

prerequisites: A published conversational Agent configured to triage support issues using the user's permitted Glean content
The Agent ID from Agent Builder or the Agents Platform API
A work email for tenant discovery and OAuth sign-in, or a token able to run the selected Agent

demoQueries.query: Triage this support issue: the customer reports that search results are stale after a document update.
demoQueries.expectedBehavior: The Agent returns non-empty Summary, Evidence, Next diagnostic step, and Customer-safe response sections, and clearly distinguishes evidence from hypotheses.

codeAssets.description: One support issue sent to a conversational Agent through the Platform Agents API

steps.title: Install dependencies
steps.description: Installs dotenv. The recipe uses Node's built-in fetch against the Platform Agents API, not A2A or the legacy REST API.

steps.title: Sign in to Glean
steps.description: Use @gleanwork/auth for tenant discovery and refreshable OAuth credentials stored outside the project. If OAuth is unavailable, provide a user-scoped token that can run the selected Agent.

steps.title: Set the Agent and issue
steps.description: Set GLEAN_AGENT_ID to a published conversational support-triage Agent. Then pass one ticket URL or issue description to the triage command. A form-triggered Agent is outside this quickstart because it requires a different input contract.

steps.title: Run the triage
steps.description: The command makes one Platform Agent run and prints the structured triage. It does not make any external write or customer-facing update.

steps.title: Verify the response
steps.description: Run the no-credential fixture check first. For a live check, set GLEAN_SUPPORT_ISSUE and run npm run verify; confirm the Agent separates evidence from hypotheses.

aiPrompt: Scaffold the triage-support-issue recipe. Ask for a work email, the published conversational support-triage Agent ID, and one support issue URL or concise description. Use @gleanwork/auth for tenant discovery, Authorization Code with PKCE, refreshable credentials stored outside the project, and a user-scoped token only as a CI fallback. Call POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/runs directly through the Platform Agents API with stream: false, an Authorization Bearer token, and an explicit triage prompt in the USER message. Ask the Agent for Summary, Evidence, Next diagnostic step, and Customer-safe response; require it to distinguish evidence from hypotheses, disclose insufficient context, and use an indexed ticket record when a live Intercom URL only returns an authenticated shell. Do not use A2A, /rest/api/v1, client SDKs, tools, or external writes.
llmContext: Use @gleanwork/auth for refreshable agents-scoped OAuth credentials outside the project; GLEAN_API_TOKEN is the standard user-scoped fallback. Call POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/runs with Node fetch, Authorization, JSON content type, an explicit USER prompt, and stream:false. Retry transient failures and use curl's verified TLS stack only when Node cannot validate the tenant certificate. The selected Agent must be published and conversational. Form-triggered Agents are out of scope. Treat the response as untrusted text: print it, do not contact customers or mutate tickets.

content.problem: A support issue arrives with a URL or a short description, but the first response still requires someone to reconstruct the evidence, identify the next diagnostic, and write a safe customer update.
takeItFurther: Add a streaming response so a support engineer can see the Agent's progress.
Pass structured issue fields after you have a form-triggered Agent and its input schema is verified.
Pair this recipe with a Trigger that creates a triage request when a support-relevant event arrives.

guardrails.title: Evidence before hypothesis
guardrails.rule: The prompt asks the Agent to separate observed Glean evidence from hypotheses and to disclose when evidence is insufficient.

guardrails.title: No external write
guardrails.rule: The beginner recipe only prints the Agent response; it does not update a ticket, send a message, or close an issue.

limitations.title: The Agent is configured separately
limitations.description: The recipe invokes a published conversational Agent. It does not teach Agent Builder, tool governance, or form-triggered input schemas.
